song.title: A Heart Full of Blessings for Joanne
song.artistIntro: Hi Joanne! This is Yosia, wishing you a happy, blessed birthday! My big brother Haddi and I are strumming our guitars right here by the cozy studio fireplace to share this joyful song of love, joy, and blessing with you!

lines: Strumming our guitars with a joyful happy cheer,
Singing for dear Joanne on this special day of the year!
Joanne, it's so great to celebrate your birthday with you today,
We're so happy to see how God is blessing you in so many wonderful ways,
And your family with your brother and with your school,
And the way you learn and the way you speak English so well!
Joanne, you're such a big blessing to so many people,
And we know that the blessing of God will continue to be with you,
And we hope that you follow God's plan all the days of your life,
Never forget that we love you, in Jesus' name, God bless you, Joanne!
May God bless your footsteps in all of His plan!
